items.q: Maman quotes a lonely friend who has nothing to do all day. A Persian saying kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Utuu kolfaa jiruu, Hooman harka isaatiin cimsee dugda koo rukuta, sukkaarichis qoonqoo koo keessatti utaala.
items.q: Hooman thumps Amir on the back while he drinks tea. A Persian image kept word for word: can you guess what happens?

items.text: Bibi, Waaqni ishee haa boqochiisu, yeroo akkanaa akkana jetti turte: "yoon dubbadhe, arrabni koo guba; yoon hin dubbatin, dhuka lafee kootu guba."
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bokkaan lafaa gara samiitti hin roobu.
items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Kanan jedhu, yoo as taa'ii walaloo qofa dubbisaa jiraatte, buddeenni siif hin ho'u.

items.text: Anumti erga maatiin humnaan lukkuu keessa na naqanii booda, akkam addunyaa adda ta'e gama sanaa akka jiru hubadhe.

items.text: Harki koo gabaabaa dha, walitti dhufeenyi kees fagoo dha.
